hints.title: Element Frequency Counting
hints.text: Unique pairs depend only on distinct numbers. Tally the frequency of each unique number in the array.

hints.title: Zero vs Positive Difference Branching
hints.text: When k is 0, each number appearing at least twice forms a valid pair. When k is greater than 0, each number x where x + k exists in the counts forms a unique pair.

hints.title: Single-Pass Lookup Verification
hints.text: Iterate over keys in the frequency counter. If k == 0 and count >= 2 increment answer; if k > 0 and (x + k) in counter increment answer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs takes quadratic O(N^2) time and requires deduplication.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting occurrences enables constant time lookups for complement x + k.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the distinct behavior between k = 0 (multiplicity >= 2) and k > 0 (presence of x + k).
